steps.label: Start with Nose Cowl / Windscreen
steps.sageInstruction: Start with RB-023, the Nose Cowl / Windscreen. This is our front reference, so bring it into position first and use its shape to guide the rest of the fairing.
steps.verificationCheck: Confirm the nose cowl is seated cleanly and the front shape looks correct before adding the trim.

steps.label: Fit Front Cowl Trim Panel
steps.sageInstruction: Now take RB-024, the Front Cowl Trim Panel. Fit it to the nose cowl and watch that the trim follows the same curve without sitting high or offset.
steps.verificationCheck: Check that the trim visually completes the front cowl area and does not create a step, gap, or obvious mismatch.

steps.label: Add Left Side Fairing Panel
steps.sageInstruction: Next, bring in RB-046, the left side fairing panel. Line up the upper front edge to the cowl first, then let the rest of the panel settle into the body shape.
steps.verificationCheck: Confirm the left panel follows the cowl smoothly and does not visibly collide with or float away from the front bodywork.

steps.label: Add Right Side Fairing Panel
steps.sageInstruction: Now bring in RB-047, the right side fairing panel. Install it the same way on the opposite side and compare it against the left panel.
steps.verificationCheck: Confirm both side panels look balanced, the gaps are even, and the four highlighted parts form one continuous outer shell.
